title: Contextual Role Playbook & Inline Permission Walkthrough
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design an in-console guided experience (playbook) that helps tenant admins assign roles and permissions with immediate previews of downstream effects: access boundaries, inherited permissions, audit log entries, and SSO mapping implications. The flow should reduce mistaken permission grants, speed up member onboarding, and create a clear, machine-readable audit trail in the Console. This ticket covers high-fidelity mockups, copy, microcopy for warnings, and interaction specs for engineering to implement the stepper overlay, inline diffs, and permission simulator.
acceptance_criteria: Guided walkthrough available from Roles list -> 'Assign member' and from Member page when adding roles
Preview pane shows: effective permissions matrix, resource-scope bubbles, and list of audit log events that will be emitted
Simulator can run a sample action (read-only) to show expected outcome for selected role before commit
Inline diff presented in compact, color-coded format summarizing access delta compared to previous role assignments
SSO/SAML identity-mapping warnings surface when an assignment would conflict with configured SSO attribute mappings
Design artifacts (Figma) linked and handed off with annotated interaction specs and accessibility notes
Edge cases documented: cross-tenant invites, role templates with conditional clauses, and delegated admin flows
Copy for confirmation & destructive-change warnings reviewed and approved by Security & Legal
design_notes: We propose a multi-step overlay (not a full-page navigation) so admins can quickly reference the context behind the Roles list. Primary panes: (1) Identity selector + source (manual invite | SSO group sync | SCIM), (2) Effective Permissions Preview (aggregates direct role grants, templates, and inherited group roles), (3) Audit & Compliance preview (what audit entries will look like, retention bucket, and export shortcuts), (4) Confirm & commit with optional justification field. Trade-offs: overlay is lighter-weight but constrained for extremely large permission matrices. For >200 permission rows we'll show a condensed summary and a link to an expanded modal. Accessibility: keyboard-first stepper, ARIA live region updates for effective permissions count, color contrast checks for diffs. Performance: the preview calls a read-only evaluation endpoint (backend-provided) that returns computed effective permissions to avoid duplicating logic client-side. We will cache last evaluation per session to avoid repeated backend calls while toggling optional flags.
decisions: Use overlay stepper pattern instead of full-page editor to keep users in context of the Roles list
Show effective permissions aggregated by resource-type and scope rather than raw permission rows by default
Add an optional 'audit preview' card that mimics the audit-log schema rather than exposing raw JSON
Require an optional justification note for assignments that expand access beyond a tenant-level boundary (policy: high-risk assignments)
Integrate a SSO-mapping validation check using the identity service; warn but do not block for now
